understood_as: Implement and unit-test reusable GC-PQN, LEO, Dual LEO(PQN), and independently specified GC-SD-SAC cores for TICK-CLAIM and PACK-RESTORE. Do not run CPU/GPU smoke, development, training, queues, or checkpoint-writing jobs in this stage.

research_interpretation.primary: test how all-goal value learning and combined Q action selection change defect exploitation
research_interpretation.not_claimed: this is not a replication of adaptation-time behavior cloning in Dual PPO
research_interpretation.dual_definition: two separately trained TD learners whose Q-values are combined for action selection

source_contracts.adaptation_boundary: adapt equations and contracts to HackRL structured inputs, terminal masks, and state containers; retain attribution; do not vendor files
use as a conformance reference for online current-network TD and Q(lambda), without replay or a target network

source_contracts.license: paper descriptions only; no implementation license inferred
source_contracts.adaptation_boundary: implement GC-SD-SAC independently from equations and pseudocode

source_contracts.license: no explicit license found at audit time
source_contracts.use: provenance boundary only; implementation text remains excluded

GC-PQN.q_lambda_boundary: the first comparison uses the official one-step default; Q(lambda) is not implemented or eligible as a hidden candidate dimension

LEO.learning: one TD target per goal and physical transition, masked by that goal's achievement or world termination
LEO.evaluation: greedy commanded-goal slice of the all-goal Q tensor

GC-SD-SAC.critic_target: reward plus discounted nonterminal exact categorical expectation of average target-Q minus alpha*log-policy
GC-SD-SAC.actor_q_aggregation: arithmetic mean of the two local critics
GC-SD-SAC.entropy_penalty: beta/2 times squared difference between stored behavior entropy and current entropy
GC-SD-SAC.q_clip: maximum of unclipped and target-reference-clipped squared TD errors for each critic
GC-SD-SAC.temperature: automatic log-alpha optimization against a frozen target entropy

exploration_schedule_contract.state: phase-local physical-transition counter stored separately from the lifetime counter
exploration_schedule_contract.pretraining: candidate must freeze epsilon start, finish, and decay fraction before normal-only development
exploration_schedule_contract.adaptation: phase-local counter restarts at zero in each symmetric fixed/mutant branch; schedule values remain identical across branches
exploration_schedule_contract.dual_mix: fixed 0.3 LEO weight has no schedule and therefore no restart

normal_gate_denominator.success: delivery/count_ge_3 achieved before the 128-step world horizon
normal_gate_denominator.common_setup: diagnostic only and excluded from the gate denominator
normal_gate_denominator.claim_boundary: an operational gate for this fixture, not proof of general learnability

evaluation_and_smoke_budget.budget_scope: evaluation and smoke budgets are additional to the training-transition totals in the parent manifest

unit_test_gates: PQN current-network one-step targets match hand calculations and expose no replay/target/Q(lambda) state
LEO per-goal terminal masks and losses match hand calculations
Dual Q combination and phase/schedule semantics match the frozen equation
SD-SAC categorical expectation, entropy, double-average target, Q-clip, terminal mask, actor penalty, and alpha loss match hand calculations
all losses and gradients are finite on deterministic synthetic batches
manifest arithmetic and the 29-of-32 gate are mechanically checked

verification.related_regression_failure_scope: two exact-equality failures in the unchanged legacy Dual path; neither the test nor src/hackrl/dual_leo.py is modified, but no clean-baseline run at the parent SHA was performed, so this does not prove causal independence
verification.ruff: not run because ruff is not installed and dependency changes are unauthorized
